title: What time is it?
body: Ask a stranger for the time, phone in your pocket.
tip: Walk up, open your mouth, survive. That's it.

title: Directions
body: Ask someone the way to a nearby place and listen to the whole answer.
tip: Actually listen instead of planning your exit.

title: Their pick
body: Ask a shop assistant or waiter what they would choose, and take it.

title: Specific compliment
body: Compliment something precise someone chose (a book, a jacket, a dog), then leave.
tip: Specific beats generic: 'great book choice' beats 'nice'.

title: The discount
body: When paying, ask for a small discount.
tip: You'll probably hear no. That's the point: smile and pay.

title: Photo, take two
body: Ask a stranger to take your photo, then ask for a second one.
tip: Asking again is the real challenge.

title: Three in a row
body: Ask three different strangers a quick question today.

title: The queue
body: In a queue, start a chat and keep it going for one minute.

title: Follow-up
body: Ask someone a question, then a second one about their answer.

title: Help me choose
body: Ask a stranger to help you pick between two items.

title: Teach me
body: Ask someone to show you something they know (a word, a trick, a shortcut).

title: Names
body: Introduce yourself by name to someone you see often but never talked to.

title: No excuse
body: Start a two-minute conversation with no pretext at all.

title: The invite
body: Invite someone you know a little for a coffee or lunch.

title: Time, again
body: Ask someone you find attractive for the time or the way.
tip: Same move as day 1. Only the person changes.

title: Their pick, again
body: In a bookshop or café, ask someone you find attractive what they'd recommend.

title: Help me choose, again
body: Ask someone you find attractive to help you pick between two items.

title: Specific compliment, again
body: Compliment someone you find attractive on something they chose, then leave.

title: Compliment + question
body: Compliment, ask one question about it, and listen.

title: One minute
body: Chat for one minute with someone you find attractive, in a queue, a class or an event.

title: Two minutes
body: Two-minute conversation with someone you find attractive, no pretext, then introduce yourself.

title: Eye contact
body: Hold eye contact and smile with three people you find attractive.

title: Hi, I'm…
body: Say hi to someone you find attractive, introduce yourself, ask their name and use it when leaving.

title: Say it
body: After a nice exchange, tell them you enjoyed talking to them.

title: Stay in touch
body: After a good conversation, ask for their Instagram or number.
tip: Wrap up first, then ask: "I have to go, but I liked talking. Can I get your Instagram?" If no: "No worries, nice talking to you."

title: The real reason
body: Tell someone honestly that you noticed them and wanted to say hi.
tip: Open with the truth: "Hi, sorry to interrupt. I noticed you and wanted to say hi. I'm [name]." Then one question about what they're doing.

title: Coffee?
body: Ask someone you've already talked to out for a coffee.
tip: Be specific: "Would you like to grab a coffee this week? Thursday?" A vague "sometime" is easy to dodge.

title: Cold coffee
body: Approach someone you don't know and ask them out for a coffee.
tip: Hi, why you came over, your name, the ask, all in under 30 seconds. Whatever the answer: smile, thank them, leave.

title: Back to day 1
body: Ask a stranger for the time. Write in your journal how it felt.

title: Your call
body: Redo the card that scared you most this month.

title: Park directions
body: Ask someone walking in a park or a street for the way.

title: Old friend
body: Message or call someone you haven't talked to in months and suggest a plan.

title: Sunday walk
body: In a park or an open café, ask someone you find attractive for a recommendation.

title: The message
body: Message someone you find attractive and propose a coffee next week.

title: The message
body: Message someone you find attractive and propose a coffee next week.

title: Notes
body: Ask the person next to you if you can look at their notes for a second.

title: Pen
body: Ask someone near you to lend you a pen.

title: Out loud
body: Ask a question out loud during class.
tip: Any question counts. Half the room was wondering the same thing.

title: After class
body: Go ask the lecturer one question after class.

title: New seat
body: Sit next to someone you've never talked to and say hi before it starts.

title: Verdict
body: Ask the person next to you what they thought of today's class.

title: Study group
body: Propose to two classmates to work together this week, with a day and a place.

title: I disagree
body: Politely disagree with something said in class, out loud, and give your reason.

title: Lunch?
body: Ask a classmate you barely know to have lunch together today.

title: To the board
body: Volunteer to answer or go to the board when nobody else does.

title: Announcement
body: Ask the lecturer for 20 seconds at the end of class to announce something (a study group, an event), and do it.

title: Join the project
body: Ask a lecturer if you could help on their research or project.
tip: Say what you'd bring, even if it's just time and motivation.

title: Second look
body: Ask a teacher to look again at a grade, with real arguments.

title: Five minutes
body: Ask the lecturer if you can explain one point to the class yourself, next session.

title: Trivia
body: Ask the person next to you a weird trivia question. (How many hearts does an octopus have? Three.)

title: Snack round
body: Offer your snack to the whole row.

title: Autograph
body: After class, ask the lecturer to sign your notes like a celebrity would.

title: Standing ovation
body: At the end of class, start a round of applause for the lecturer.

title: Theme day
body: Ask the lecturer if next week's class can have a dress code (hats, shirts, colours). Make the pitch.

title: New faces
body: At the break, each of you introduces yourself to a classmate you've never talked to.

title: Question relay
body: In the same class, each of you asks the lecturer one question out loud.

title: Settle it
body: Before class, ask the people nearby to settle a debate between you two (cats or dogs, pineapple pizza).

title: Pen, please
body: Ask someone you find attractive to lend you a pen. Give it back with a thank-you and a smile.

title: Compare notes
body: After class, ask someone you find attractive to compare notes.

title: Walk out together
body: Walk out with someone you find attractive after class and keep the chat going to the exit.

title: Coffee after class
body: Ask someone you find attractive from your class to grab a coffee right after.
tip: Specific and now: "I'm getting a coffee, want to come?"

title: Rate my doodle
body: Show someone you find attractive a doodle from your notes and ask them to rate it out of 10.

title: Charger
body: Ask someone if they can lend you a charger.

title: Free seat?
body: Ask if the seat next to someone is free, and sit there.

title: Guard my stuff
body: Ask someone to watch your things while you get a coffee.

title: Librarian's pick
body: Ask the librarian for a book recommendation outside your field, and borrow it.

title: What's that?
body: Ask someone what they're reading and whether it's good.

title: Explain it
body: Ask someone studying your subject to explain one thing you don't get.

title: Window seat
body: Ask someone to swap their window seat with you.

title: Lower it
body: Politely ask a noisy group to keep it down.

title: Coffee break
body: Ask someone studying nearby to take a coffee break with you.

title: Study partner
body: Ask someone you often see there if they want to study together next time.

title: Book oracle
body: Ask a stranger to open your book at a random page and read you one sentence. That's your advice for the day.

title: Dragon cookbook
body: Ask the librarian, straight-faced, for a cookbook for dragons. See what they suggest.

title: Whisper review
body: Whisper-ask five people their favourite book, and write the list down.

title: Two whispers
body: Each of you gets a stranger to tell you their favourite book. Compare picks over coffee.

title: Highlighter
body: Ask someone you find attractive if you can borrow their highlighter.

title: Study break
body: Ask someone you find attractive what they're studying, then if they want a coffee break.

title: Barista's choice
body: Order "whatever you'd drink".

title: Wifi
body: Ask the person next to you for the wifi password.

title: Shared table
body: When it's busy, ask to share a table.

title: Worth it?
body: Ask the person next to you what they ordered and if it's good.

title: Taste first
body: Ask to taste something before you order it.

title: Free refill
body: Ask for a free refill of your coffee.

title: Ten minutes
body: Ask someone sitting alone if you can join them for ten minutes.

title: Their story
body: Ask the staff how long they've worked there and what the best part is.

title: On the house
body: Ask if your drink can be on the house today.
tip: Just ask, smile, then pay normally whatever they say.

title: Behind the counter
body: Ask the barista if you can make your own coffee behind the counter.

title: Table talk
body: Ask a table of strangers if you can join their conversation for five minutes.

title: Bad joke
body: Tell the barista or cashier a (clean) bad joke.

title: DJ request
body: Ask the bar or café to play a specific song.

title: Foam art
body: Ask for a specific drawing in your latte foam: a cat, a rocket, a tiny shark.

title: Name a drink
body: Ask the barista to invent a drink for you and give it a name.

title: Pastry judge
body: Ask the person next to you to rate your pastry choice out of 10, with reasons.

title: Sung order
body: Sing your order. One line, any tune.

title: Round of applause
body: Get the café to applaud the barista. You start it, out loud, with a reason.

title: Two tables
body: Each of you asks a different table what's best here. Best tip wins.

title: Join in
body: Together, ask a group if you can join their game or quiz table.

title: Surprise me
body: Each of you asks the barista to pick a drink for the other. No veto.

title: The smile
body: Smile at someone you find attractive and say hi as you pass.

title: Your order?
body: Ask someone you find attractive what they ordered and if it's good.

title: Mind if I sit?
body: Ask someone you find attractive if you can sit at their table, then talk.

title: Second coffee
body: Offer to buy the next coffee for someone you've just chatted with and find attractive, and stay for it.

title: Rate the art
body: Ask someone you find attractive to rate your latte art out of 10.

title: The dog
body: Ask someone if you can pet their dog.

title: Local tip
body: Ask someone for the best place to eat nearby.

title: Photo swap
body: Offer to take a photo for a group, then ask them to take yours.

title: Five hellos
body: Say hello to five strangers you pass, out loud, with eye contact.

title: What do you think?
body: Ask a stranger what they think of a building, a mural or a shop window next to you.

title: Best advice
body: Ask three strangers for the best advice they ever got. Write the answers down.

title: Five compliments
body: Give five sincere compliments to five strangers within 30 minutes.

title: Walk with me
body: Ask someone going your way if you can walk together for a bit.

title: Bench talk
body: Sit near someone on a bench and start a conversation.

title: One euro
body: Ask a stranger to lend you one euro, say it's for a courage challenge, and give it back right away.

title: Sell it
body: Try to sell a stranger an apple for one euro. Pitch it properly.

title: Busker
body: Ask a busker if you can sing or play one song with them.
tip: If they say yes, you sing. That's the deal.

title: Count to ten
body: Ask someone to count to ten in their language.

title: Rock, paper, scissors
body: Challenge a stranger to one round.

title: Superhero name
body: Ask a stranger to give you a superhero name. Use it all day.

title: Forecast
body: Ask a stranger for tomorrow's weather forecast, delivered like on TV.

title: Movie of my life
body: Ask a stranger to guess the title of the movie of your life.

title: Rate my walk
body: Walk past a stranger, come back, and ask them to rate your walk out of 10.

title: Street reporter
body: Interview a stranger for one minute like a TV reporter, phone as the mic. Ask before filming.

title: Same destination
body: Each of you asks a different stranger the way to the same place. Compare routes.

title: Compliment duel
body: Each of you gives a stranger a sincere compliment. The other judges.

title: High five
body: Each of you gets a high five from a stranger.

title: Quick poll
body: Ask five strangers the same silly question (best pizza topping?) and tally the answers.

title: Squad photo
body: Ask a group of strangers to jump into your photo.

title: Camera crew
body: One films, one interviews a stranger about their day. Ask before filming. Then swap.

title: Which way?
body: Ask someone you find attractive for the way somewhere.

title: Style compliment
body: Compliment the style of someone you find attractive, then keep walking.

title: Same way
body: Ask someone you find attractive going your way if you can walk together.

title: Just wanted to say hi
body: Stop someone you find attractive and tell them honestly you noticed them and wanted to say hi.
tip: Name, the honest reason, one question. Under 30 seconds. Any answer: smile and thank them.

title: Guess my job
body: Ask someone you find attractive to guess what you do or study.

title: Where is it?
body: Ask a staff member where something is.

title: Wrong shop
body: Ask for something the shop obviously doesn't sell.

title: Price check
body: Ask for a discount at the till.

title: Gift advice
body: Ask a staff member what they'd buy for a friend with 20 euros.

title: Honest opinion
body: Try something on and ask a stranger what they think.

title: Two for less
body: Ask for a better price if you buy two.

title: Staff favourite
body: Ask the cashier what they'd never buy here, and why.

title: Backstage
body: Ask if you can see the stockroom or the kitchen.

title: Sample, please
body: Ask for a free sample of something that doesn't have samples.

title: Shop assistant
body: Ask the manager if you can sell for them for ten minutes.

title: Never buy
body: Ask the baker which pastry they'd never pick, and why.

title: Guess the total
body: Ask the cashier to guess your total before scanning.

title: Mannequin
body: Ask a staff member to take a photo of you copying the mannequin's pose.

title: Scent check
body: Ask a stranger in a perfume shop which scent suits you best.

title: The announcement
body: Ask to use the shop's microphone to wish a nice day to everyone.

title: Opinion poll
body: Pick one item together; each of you asks a different stranger's opinion on it, then compare.

title: Style check
body: Each of you tries on the worst item you can find and asks a stranger if it suits you.

title: Stylist swap
body: Each of you picks an outfit for the other and asks staff to rate both.

title: Second opinion
body: Ask someone you find attractive which of two items they'd pick.

title: Signature scent
body: Ask someone you find attractive which perfume they'd pick for you.

title: Rate the shirt
body: Hold up a shirt and ask someone you find attractive to rate it out of 10.

title: Which stop?
body: Ask someone which stop is best for a place.

title: Thanks, driver
body: Thank the driver out loud when you get off.

title: The window
body: Ask someone if they mind opening or closing the window.

title: Seat swap
body: Ask someone to swap seats with you.

title: Small talk
body: Comment on something around you to the person next to you.

title: Where to?
body: Ask the person next to you where they're heading today, and why.

title: Too loud
body: Politely ask someone to lower their music or their call.

title: All the way
body: Keep a conversation going with a stranger until your stop.

title: Next station
body: Ask a train or tram driver if you can make the next stop announcement.

title: Fun fact
body: Ask a stranger for one fun fact about this city.

title: Lucky numbers
body: Ask a stranger to pick your lucky numbers for the week.

title: What's playing?
body: Ask someone with headphones what they're listening to, and if you can hear ten seconds.

title: Tour guide
body: Narrate the next stop like a tour guide to the person next to you.

title: Two stops
body: Each of you starts a chat with a stranger before the next stop.

title: Fact hunt
body: Each of you collects a fun fact from a stranger. Best fact wins.

title: Free seat
body: Ask someone you find attractive if the seat next to them is free, then sit.

title: Good playlist?
body: Ask someone you find attractive what they're listening to.

title: Before my stop
body: Before your stop, tell someone you've chatted with that it was nice, and ask for their Instagram.

title: First ten minutes
body: Introduce yourself to someone you don't know within 10 minutes.

title: The host
body: Ask the host to introduce you to someone.

title: The circle
body: Join a group that's already talking.

title: Five names
body: Learn and use the names of five new people tonight.

title: Matchmaker
body: Introduce two people who don't know each other.

title: DJ, please
body: Ask the DJ to play your song.

title: A toast
body: Raise your glass and give a short toast to the group.

title: Group chat
body: Get three new people's numbers to make a group for the next plan.

title: The mic
body: Get the mic and say something to the whole room.

title: Two truths
body: Play two truths and a lie with someone you just met.

title: Teach me a move
body: Ask someone to teach you a dance move, then do it.

title: Palm reading
body: Ask someone if you can read their palm, and give them an absurd but kind future.

title: Dance-off
body: Challenge someone to a dance-off.

title: Wingman
body: Your friend introduces you to a stranger, then you do the same for them.

title: Split and swap
body: Split up: each of you introduces yourself to someone new, then you introduce your new people to each other.

title: First on the floor
body: Be the first two dancing.

title: Hi, I'm…
body: Introduce yourself to someone you find attractive and ask their name.

title: Dance?
body: Ask someone you find attractive to dance.

title: The number
body: After a good chat, ask for their number.
tip: Wrap up first: "I have to go, I liked talking to you. Can I get your number?"

title: Double intro
body: Each of you introduces yourself to someone you find attractive.

title: Dance battle
body: Challenge someone you find attractive to a dance-off.

title: Is it free?
body: Ask if a machine or bench is free.

title: Share the machine
body: Ask to share a machine between sets.

title: Show me
body: Ask someone how a machine works.

title: Good form
body: Compliment someone's technique or progress.

title: Spot me
body: Ask someone to spot you on a set.

title: Their program
body: Ask someone who looks experienced what their program is.

title: Form check
body: Ask a stranger to watch one set and correct your form.

title: Guest pass
body: Ask the front desk for a free day pass for a friend.

title: Train together
body: Ask someone to do a workout together next time.

title: Lead the warm-up
body: Ask the instructor if you can lead the warm-up of the class.

title: Count my reps
body: Ask someone to count your reps out loud.

title: Gym DJ
body: Ask the staff to put your song on.

title: Hype man
body: Ask a stranger to cheer you through your last set.

title: Arm wrestling
body: Challenge someone to an arm-wrestling match.

title: Partner set
body: Each of you asks a stranger to join you for one set.

title: Cheer squad
body: Ask a stranger if you two can cheer their last rep, then do it loudly.

title: Quick tip
body: Ask someone you find attractive for a tip on an exercise.

title: Spot, please
body: Ask someone you find attractive to spot you.

title: Smoothie after?
body: Ask someone you find attractive if they want a smoothie after the workout.

title: Old friend
body: Message a friend you haven't talked to in six months.

title: The call
body: Call someone you'd usually just text.

title: Voice note
body: Send a voice message instead of a text.

title: Neighbour
body: Introduce yourself to a neighbour you've never talked to.

title: The plan
body: Propose a concrete plan to someone: day, time, place.

title: A cup of sugar
body: Knock at a neighbour's door to borrow something.

title: Better deal
body: Call your phone or internet provider and ask for a better price.

title: Cold email
body: Email someone you admire with one precise question.

title: Honest feedback
body: Ask a friend for one honest piece of feedback about you.

title: Fifteen minutes
body: Ask someone doing a job you'd like for a 15-minute call.

title: Long shot
body: Apply for something you feel under-qualified for.

title: Ask for more
body: Ask for a raise, a better grade or better terms, with your arguments ready.

title: Absurd poll
body: Send your group chat a poll on a ridiculous question, and defend your vote.

title: Pizza art
body: Order a pizza and ask for a smiley made of toppings.

title: Thank-you call
body: Call a company's customer service only to thank them for something.

title: Random birthday
body: Call a friend and sing them a song on a random day. Full song.

title: Call night
body: Same evening, each of you calls someone you haven't spoken to in a year.

title: Real reply
body: Reply to a story of someone you like with a real comment or question.

title: Voice, not text
body: Send a voice note to someone you like.

title: Ask by text
body: Ask someone you like out by message, with a day and a place.

title: Wingman
body: Your friend starts a chat with someone you find attractive, then introduces you. Swap next time.

title: Two approaches
body: Each of you says hi to someone you find attractive. The other one watches and debriefs.

title: Settle our debate
body: Together, ask someone you find attractive to settle a silly debate between you two.

title: Rate our order
body: Together, ask someone you find attractive which of your two drinks looks better.

title: Grandma's recipe
body: Ask a stranger for the best recipe their family makes.

title: Name my bag
body: Ask a stranger to give your bag a name. Introduce the bag to the next person you talk to.

title: Autograph, in advance
body: Ask a stranger for their autograph, for when they're famous.

title: Guess the song
body: Hum a song and ask a stranger to guess it.

title: Award ceremony
body: Give a stranger an award (best coat of the day) with a ten-second speech.

title: Thumb war
body: Challenge a stranger to a thumb war.

title: Imaginary dog
body: Ask a stranger if they want to pet your imaginary dog. Describe the dog.

title: Air guitar
body: Play a ten-second air guitar solo and ask a stranger to rate it.

title: Napkin fortune
body: Write a fortune on a napkin and give it to the barista.

title: Tasting notes
body: Describe your coffee to the barista like a wine expert, then ask if they agree.

title: Cheers
body: Ask the next table to raise their cups with you, for no reason at all.

title: Five-euro dinner
body: Ask the greengrocer or butcher what you should cook tonight with five euros.

title: One banana
body: Negotiate the price of a single banana, seriously.

title: Photoshoot
body: In a changing room queue, ask staff to direct you like a fashion shoot for one photo.

title: Guess my name
body: Ask the person next to you to guess your name. Give hints.

title: Thirty-second portrait
body: Ask a stranger to draw you in 30 seconds in your notebook.

title: Good morning, everyone
body: Say "Good morning everyone, have a great day" to the whole carriage.

title: Pass it on
body: Compliment someone and ask them to pass a compliment on to someone else.

title: Red carpet
body: Interview a guest as if they were a celebrity on a red carpet.

title: Conga
body: Start a conga line. Recruit at least three people.

title: Victory pose
body: Ask someone to take a photo of your victory pose after your last set.

title: Pep talk
body: Ask a stranger for a ten-second motivational speech before your set.

title: Riddle
body: Ask the person next to you a riddle. They have until the end of class.

title: Better title
body: After class, pitch the lecturer a funnier title for the course.

title: Shoe-based advice
body: Ask a stranger to recommend you a book based only on your shoes.

title: Product idea
body: Email a brand you like with a product idea for them.

title: Compliment call
body: Call a friend just to give them three specific compliments, then hang up.

title: Walk me there
body: Ask someone for directions, then ask if they'd walk you there.

title: Lunch, now
body: Ask a stranger to have lunch with you, now.
tip: Say why: you're practising meeting people. Pay for yourself, not for them.

title: Yesterday's pastry
body: Ask if you can have one of yesterday's pastries for free.

title: Meet the owner
body: Ask to speak to the owner and ask them one question about running the place.

title: Expired coupon
body: Ask to use an expired coupon or last week's promotion.

title: Try it at home
body: Ask if you can borrow an item for a day before deciding to buy it.

title: Speak first
body: In a group meeting, speak first and propose a plan.

title: Your seat?
body: Ask someone to give you their seat, with no reason. Accept the no, and thank them.

title: Leave with a plan
body: Before leaving, set a concrete plan with someone you met tonight.

title: Ten free minutes
body: Ask a coach for a free ten-minute session.

title: Poster
body: Ask the library if you can put up a poster for your study group.

title: Give a talk
body: Ask an event organiser if you can give a five-minute talk at their next event.
